acceptanceCriteria: A CEM hunk can carry a coverage witness naming the coverprofile digest, test run identity and covered line ranges; uncovered hunks are reported as such, never inferred as tested.
TCQ downgrades a `tested` claim whose hunk has no coverage witness, with the reason visible in the reviewer report.
The TCQ spec exclusion is replaced by numbered requirements with tests, and the wire change is additive.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: coverage is consumed only in internal/liveverify/gorunner and docs/specs/test-claim-qualification-v0.md lists coverage ingestion as excluded. Admit a minimum `test touches hunk` witness computed from a local Go coverprofile with diff-cover semantics, pinned to the CEM hunk and the test run identity, so a passing test that never executes a changed hunk cannot qualify it. Owning specs: docs/specs/test-claim-qualification-v0.md, docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md.
title: tcq: patch coverage witness from a local coverprofile
